outcome: uterocervical angle (UCA) values measured by transvaginal sonography (TVS)
cohort: 242 low-risk pregnant women with anteflexed uterus, no history of cesarean section, and term delivery
finding: The normal range of UCA values in low-risk pregnant women at 16-24 weeks of gestation was 63.0 to 148.8 degrees, with no significant changes observed across this gestational age period.
